title: Apple Announces 3D MLB Games Coming to Vision Pro
excerpt: Apple and MLB today released the September schedule for Apple TV's weekly Friday Night Baseball doubleheader. The games are included with an...
content_html:
Apple and MLB today released the September schedule for Apple TV's weekly Friday Night Baseball doubleheader. The games are included with an Apple TV subscription at no additional cost, and there is a new perk for Vision Pro users.


For the first time, Friday Night Baseball will be streamed live in the Apple Immersive format, allowing Vision Pro users to watch a 3D video feed recorded in 8K with a 180º field of view. The first game streamed in Apple Immersive will see the Boston Red Sox face the New York Yankees on Friday, August 28 at 7 p.m. Eastern Time.

Vision Pro users with an Apple TV subscription in Australia, Canada, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the U.K., and the U.S. can stream the games live in Apple Immersive directly through the Apple TV app. Full game replays and highlights will be available on demand in the Apple TV app for the Vision Pro.

"On August 28, viewers with Vision Pro will experience the iconic Red Sox vs. Yankees rivalry from unique camera angles that place viewers right in the game, immersed in the drama of each at-bat, the celebrations in the dugout after a big hit, close plays at the outfield wall, and more," said Apple, in a press release.

Apple said team lineups and stats will float on screen, and there will be a stadium view with Spatial Audio during breaks in the action.

Four out of seven of the Friday Night Baseball games in September will be streamed in Apple Immersive, with a full schedule provided in Apple's announcement.

content_html_zh:
Apple 和 MLB 今天发布了 Apple TV 每周周五晚上棒球双赛的 9 月份赛程表。 这些游戏包含在 Apple TV 订阅中，无需额外付费，并且 Vision Pro 用户还有一项新福利。

周五棒球之夜 (Friday Night Baseball) 首次以 Apple Immersive 格式进行直播，Vision Pro 用户可以观看以 8K 录制的 180° 视野 3D 视频。 在 Apple Immersive 中直播的第一场比赛将在 8 月 28 日星期五晚上 7 点观看波士顿红袜队对阵纽约洋基队。 东部时间。

在澳大利亚、加拿大、德国、香港、日本、韩国、台湾、英国和美国订阅 Apple TV 的 Vision Pro 用户可以直接通过 Apple TV 应用在 Apple Immersive 中直播游戏。 完整的比赛重播和精彩片段将在 Vision Pro 的 Apple TV 应用程序中按需提供。

苹果在一份新闻稿中表示：“8 月 28 日，观看 Vision Pro 的观众将从独特的摄像机角度体验标志性的红袜队与洋基队的对抗，让观众身临其境，沉浸在每次击球的戏剧性、大击球后教练席的庆祝活动、外场墙的激烈比赛等等中。”

苹果表示，球队阵容和统计数据将浮动在屏幕上，并且在比赛休息期间将通过 Spatial Audio 呈现体育场视图。

9 月份的周五晚上棒球比赛中，有四场将在 Apple Immersive 中进行直播，完整的赛程表已在 Apple 公告中提供。
